description: This is a Java source file defining a custom watch face service for Android Wear OS using OpenGL rendering. It includes classes and methods for rendering clock hands, ticks, and managing camera angles in 3D space, with support for ambient and interactive modes.

classes.name: OpenGLWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending Gles2WatchFaceService, responsible for creating the watch face engine.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending Gles2WatchFaceService.Engine, handles OpenGL context creation, rendering, and mode changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face style and sets up the service.

methods.name: onGlContextCreated
methods.description: Sets up OpenGL program, creates clock hands and tick marks, precomputes camera and clock angles.

methods.name: onGlSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Configures projection matrix based on surface size and precomputes view-projection matrices.

methods.name: createHand
methods.description: Creates a triangle shape for clock hands with specified size and color.

methods.name: createMajorTicks
methods.description: Creates triangles for major tick marks.

methods.name: createMinorTicks
methods.description: Creates triangles for minor tick marks.

methods.name: getMajorTickTriangleCoords
methods.description: Calculates coordinates for major tick triangles at specific angles.

methods.name: getMinorTickTriangleCoords
methods.description: Calculates coordinates for minor tick triangles at specific angles.

methods.name: getTickTriangleCoords
methods.description: Generates triangle coordinates for tick marks at given angles.

methods.name: rotateCoords
methods.description: Rotates coordinate points in XY plane by specified degrees.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Handles transition into or out of ambient mode.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Registers or unregisters timezone receiver based on visibility.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Updates display on each time tick.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the watch face, including clock hands, ticks, and background, adapting to ambient or interactive mode.
